harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, mariadb-server 10.11 + galera-4), created an appdb database with a customers table and appuser credentials, and confirmed multi-master replication among the three. Then added node4 as a fourth member: configured Galera to join the existing cluster, started mariadb which triggered an SST copying all existing data, and verified node4 accepts writes that replicate to the other three. Finally performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full Galera quorum/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Fixed a plain-HTTP apt mirror stall (port 80 blackholed, HTTPS worked) by switching ubuntu.sources to https:// on all 4 nodes
Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-client, galera-4, rsync on node1-node4
Configured 60-galera.cnf on node1-node3 with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 and bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster on node1
Started mariadb on node2/node3 to join; confirmed wsrep_cluster_size=3, all Synced
Generated appuser password on node1 via openssl rand; created appdb database, appuser@'%' grant, and customers table with sample rows
Verified replication and multi-master writes across node1-node3
Reconfigured node1-node3 wsrep_cluster_address to include node4; configured node4's 60-galera.cnf to join as gcomm://node1,node2,node3,node4
Started mariadb on node4 triggering SST that copied existing appdb data; confirmed wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, correct row count
Verified node4 accepts writes replicated to node1/node3, and appuser can authenticate remotely against node4
Captured pre-restart boot_id and Galera health baseline on all 4 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved each time), confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each
Performed final cross-cluster write/read consistency check after all restarts

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster running on node1-3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, node2/node3 joined (wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced), appdb.customers created and populated, write from node2 replicated to node1

evidence.requirement: node4 added as 4th member carrying existing data
evidence.summary: node4 configured and started; wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, and customers table shows 4 rows via SST from the cluster

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like other members
evidence.summary: Insert on node4 replicated to node1 and node3; appuser authenticated remotely against node4 and queried data

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a captured; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id 748b169c confirms restart; mariadb active, wsrep_cluster_size=4 Synced, data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4 captured; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id dcefb23a confirms restart; mariadb active, wsrep_cluster_size=4 Synced, data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df9e2dce captured; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id c2008cc4 confirms restart; mariadb active, wsrep_cluster_size=4 Synced, data intact

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3fad4432 captured; reboot triggered; post-reboot boot_id 21b4e6d6 confirms restart; mariadb active, wsrep_cluster_size=4 Synced, incoming_addresses shows all 4 nodes, data intact

evidence.requirement: Post-restart full-cluster consistency and write test
evidence.summary: Insert on node4 after all restarts replicated correctly to node1, node2, node3 (all showing 6 rows), wsrep_cluster_size=4
